image_description: A Nile crocodile is partially submerged in murky, yellowish-green water, with only the top of its head, eyes, nostrils, and dorsal ridge visible above the surface. Green aquatic vegetation hangs from the left bank into the water. The crocodile's skin appears textured with osteoderms. There is a faint, illegible text watermark in the bottom right corner.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the snout shows the characteristic tapering V-shape of a crocodilian, distinct from the U-shape of an alligator.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed and the jawline is submerged or obscured by the water line; teeth are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is clearly visible on the top of the head (dorsal positioning), allowing the animal to see while submerged. Vertical pupil structure is discernible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nostrils are clearly visible as raised bumps at the very end of the snout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible dorsal ridge indicates an elongated body structure typical of crocodiles.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture of the skin above the water line shows distinct, rough, bony protrusions consistent with osteoderms.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration matches the description, appearing greyish-brown with high surface texture.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral surface is completely submerged and invisible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All limbs are submerged and not visible in the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in the image.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a string of characters 'RB.BW...' which appears to be a watermark or signature. It is slightly blurry and lacks the crisp edges of native digital text, suggesting minor generation artifacting or compression issues common in AI images.

The interaction between the crocodile's snout and the water lacks realistic displacement ripples. The water line appears somewhat 'painted on' or static rather than physically reacting to the solid object breaking the surface tension.
